The belief: a record is a class whose properties can't change. Write

It's a reasonable reading of the most common syntax.

blocks.title: Records make poor EF Core entities

content.text: Entity Framework Core relies on reference equality to keep one instance per entity, and it doesn't support updating immutable entity types. Microsoft's docs say records aren't appropriate as EF Core entity types. Use classes for entities, and records for the DTOs, messages and queries around them.
